subject: E-Commerce
title: Dynamic Personalization Engines
description: A 60-second lesson on Dynamic Personalization Engines.

hook.text: Two people visiting the same store at the same time see different products, prices, and layouts.

buildup.text: AI personalization engines analyze your behavior in real-time and rearrange the entire shopping experience for you.

discovery.text: Amazon's homepage shows different products to every visitor. The same URL displays a different store for each person.

twist.text: Personalization can mean personalized pricing. Airlines already charge different prices based on browsing history.

climax.text: Hyper-personalization improves relevance but enables discrimination. The same power that helps you can also exploit you.

punchline.text: Same URL, different store for everyone. Personalization helps you find.

quiz.question: What is the dark side of AI-powered personalization in e-commerce?
options: It enables personalized pricing that can charge different people different amounts
